description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Chameleon Colossus by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is its power.
Repeat step 2 until Chameleon Colossus has power 20 or greater.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.
